top_signals.title: Police raid Starbucks Korea’s headquarters in Seoul over ‘Tank Day’ event
top_signals.summary: The raid by the Seoul Metropolitan Police Agency came months after the coffee chain's "Tank Day" promotion was accused of insulting victims of South Korea's democracy movement.
